title: Aramark Healthcare+ Named Top Overall Supplier on Modern Healthcare's "Best Places to Work™ in Healthcare" List
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Aramark's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://aramark.gcs-web.com/node/24606/pdf)


PHILADELPHIA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 21, 2026--[Aramark Healthcare+](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aramark.com%2Findustries%2Fhealthcare%2Fhealthcare-plus&esheet=54607230&newsitemid=20260921732239&lan=en-US&anchor=Aramark+Healthcare%2B&index=1&md5=1de20d6c099c9201ddeb5695e1aee97b) ranked number one overall supplier organization on Modern Healthcare's["Best Places to Work™ in Healthcare" list](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.modernhealthcare.com%2Fawards%2Fbest-places-to-work%2F2026%2F&esheet=54607230&newsitemid=20260921732239&lan=en-US&anchor=%26quot%3BBest+Places+to+Work%26%238482%3B+in+Healthcare%26quot%3B+list&index=2&md5=142f0ce0c21c4d5a62c5c3925a0792ee) and, for the third consecutive year, was named top Large Supplier.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260921732239/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260921732239/en/)


Aramark Healthcare+ leaders, including President and CEO Paul "PJ" Johnson (center), celebrate at Modern Healthcare's "Best Places to Work in Healthcare" awards gala following the organization's recognition as the number one overall supplier organization and, for the third consecutive year, the top-ranked Large Supplier.


"Being recognized by Modern Healthcare, particularly as the top-ranked supplier organization, reflects our ability to attract, develop, and retain talent at scale, which is critical to supporting healthcare organizations and delivering industry-leading service across the more than 600 healthcare facilities we serve. We celebrate this recognition alongside our clients because our mission is to help them improve outcomes and enhance the experiences of the patients, caregivers, and communities they serve,” said Paul "PJ" Johnson, President and CEO of Aramark Healthcare+.


Aramark Healthcare+ earned this recognition as a result of its investment in employee development, including leadership training, certifications, and career advancement programs.


In addition to earning the program's highest overall ranking among supplier organizations in 2026, the company was also named the top Healthiest Workplace and placed 3rd Family-Friendliest Workplace.


The annual program drew more than 700 applicants and recognized 150 organizations nationwide, including 75 healthcare providers and 75 healthcare supplier organizations.


The honors build on a growing list of workplace recognitions earned through Modern Healthcare's "Best Places to Work in Healthcare™" program, including:


- [#1 Large Supplier (2024, 2025, 2026)](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aramark.com%2Fnewsroom%2Fnews%2F2025%2Foctober%2Faramark-healthcare--named--1-large-supplier-on-modern-healthcare&esheet=54607230&newsitemid=20260921732239&lan=en-US&anchor=%231+Large+Supplier+%282024%2C+2025%2C+2026%29&index=3&md5=fb18c8feec084813304cdab00aa6c452)
- **#1 Healthiest Workplace (2025, 2026)**
- **#1 in Community Impact (2024)**
- **#3 Family-Friendliest Workplace (2025, 2026)**


Aramark Healthcare+ supports more than 600 healthcare facilities across 47 states through food and nutrition services, environmental services, facilities management, and clinical technology management. The organization employs more than 25,000 managed and direct teammates dedicated to helping healthcare organizations improve operations and support positive patient, visitor, and caregiver experiences.


**About Aramark**


Aramark (NYSE: ARMK) proudly serves the world’s leading educational institutions, Fortune 500 companies, world champion sports teams, prominent healthcare providers, iconic destinations and cultural attractions, and numerous municipalities in 16 countries around the world with food and facilities management. Because of our hospitality culture, our employees strive to do great things for each other, our partners, our communities, and the planet. Learn more at[www.aramark.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.aramark.com&esheet=54607230&newsitemid=20260921732239&lan=en-US&anchor=www.aramark.com&index=4&md5=3abca43f7c92a3a6094729f3cdaefd2d) and connect with us on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.


**About Aramark Healthcare+**


[Aramark Healthcare+](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aramark.com%2Findustries%2Fhealthcare%2Fhealthcare-plus&esheet=54607230&newsitemid=20260921732239&lan=en-US&anchor=Aramark+Healthcare%2B&index=5&md5=8598f0fcc4f789ac72818e2eb6c60d1f) is a national leader in healthcare dining, nutrition, environmental services, and facilities management, supporting more than 600 healthcare facilities across the United States. By combining hospitality, science, and culinary expertise, Aramark Healthcare+ redefines the hospital experience and helps improve patient outcomes. Aramark Healthcare+ has been named the #1 Large Supplier on Modern Healthcare's "Best Places to Work in Healthcare" list for three consecutive years, reflecting its people-first culture and operational excellence across the healthcare industry.
